name: STAR Geometry — spherical and cylindrical to rectangular coordinates
summary: Spherical and cylindrical coordinates to rectangular and back; agrees with ERFA, SPICE and astropy to 3e-16 relative and 6e-14 deg on 600 cases in both directions, close to the axis included, and refuses out-of-range input.
reference: definition x = r cos(lat) cos(lon), y = r cos(lat) sin(lon), z = r sin(lat) (Explanatory Supplement to the Astronomical Almanac); exact case by hand: lon 60 deg, lat 0, r 2 is (1, sqrt(3), 0)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: angles in degrees, lengths in the caller's unit; longitude from +x towards +y, latitude from the xy plane; output ranges stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; undefined longitude on the axis returned as 0 and documented; no iteration
